import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int K;
    static Matrix[] table[];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] data;
        int rows, cols;

        Matrix() {
            rows = 0;
            cols = 0;
            data = new long[0][0];
        }

        Matrix(int rows, int cols) {
            this.rows = rows;
            this.cols = cols;
            data = new long[rows][cols];
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        static Matrix identityMatrix(int n) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                res.data[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            assert rows == other.rows && cols == other.cols;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
                    res.data[i][j] = (data[i][j] + other.data[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix other) {
            assert rows == other.rows && cols == other.cols;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
                    res.data[i][j] = (data[i][j] - other.data[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            assert cols == other.rows;
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows, other.cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
                for (int k = 0; k < cols; ++k) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < other.cols; ++j) {
                        res.data[i][j] = (res.data[i][j] + data[i][k] * other.data[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix power(long exponent) {
            Matrix result = identityMatrix(rows);
            Matrix base = this;
            while (exponent > 0) {
                if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exponent >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        long computeDeterminant() {
            Matrix copy = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
                    copy.data[i][j] = data[i][j];
                }
            }
            assert rows == cols;
            long det = 1;
            int n = rows;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                int pivot = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (copy.data[j][i] != 0) {
                        pivot = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (pivot == -1) return 0;
                if (i != pivot) {
                    det = (det * (MOD - 1)) % MOD;
                    long[] temp = copy.data[i];
                    copy.data[i] = copy.data[pivot];
                    copy.data[pivot] = temp;
                }
                det = (det * copy.data[i][i]) % MOD;
                long inv = modInverse(copy.data[i][i], MOD);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    copy.data[i][j] = (copy.data[i][j] * inv) % MOD;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                    long factor = copy.data[j][i];
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                        copy.data[j][k] = (copy.data[j][k] - copy.data[i][k] * factor) % MOD;
                        if (copy.data[j][k] < 0) copy.data[j][k] += MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return (det % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        private long modInverse(long a, long mod) {
            long m = mod, x = 0, y = 1;
            if (mod == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                long q = a / mod;
                long t = mod;
                mod = a % mod;
                a = t;
                t = x;
                x = y - q * x;
                y = t;
            }
            if (y < 0) y += m;
            return y;
        }

        void cyclicShift() {
            Matrix temp = new Matrix(rows, cols);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                    temp.data[i][j] = data[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K];
                }
                temp.data[i][K] = data[(i + K - 1) % K][K];
                temp.data[K][i] = data[K][(i + K - 1) % K];
            }
            temp.data[K][K] = data[K][K];
            data = temp.data;
        }
    }

    static long fastPow(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        long half = fastPow(base, exp / 2);
        long result = (half * half) % MOD;
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N_input = scanner.nextLong();
        long K_input = scanner.nextLong();
        K = (int) K_input;

        long depth = 0;
        long temp = N_input;
        while (temp >= K) {
            depth++;
            temp /= K;
        }

        table = new Matrix[(int) depth + 1][K + 1];

        table[0][0] = Matrix.identityMatrix(K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            table[0][0].data[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            table[0][i] = table[0][i - 1];
            table[0][i].cyclicShift();
        }

        for (long level = 1; level <= depth; ++level) {
            table[(int) level][0] = table[(int) level - 1][0];
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                table[(int) level][0] = table[(int) level - 1][i].multiply(table[(int) level][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
                table[(int) level][i] = table[(int) level][i - 1];
                table[(int) level][i].cyclicShift();
            }
        }

        Matrix result = new Matrix(K + 1, 1);
        result.data[K][0] = 1;
        int shift_count = 0;

        while (depth >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
                if (fastPow(K, depth) <= N_input) {
                    N_input -= fastPow(K, depth);
                    result = table[(int) depth][shift_count].multiply(result);
                    shift_count = (shift_count + 1) % K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            depth--;
        }

        long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; ++i) {
            sum = (sum + result.data[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(sum);
    }
}
